verdict.rationale: Avalara AvaTax is a tax-compliance platform with configurable tax logic and MCP/AI tooling, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations or rule configurations is a fair axis to evaluate. The evidence pack covers tax calculation, transactions, nexus, SDKs, and MCP tools, but contains nothing on version history, change review, or rollback of automations or configurations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
